# docs/intake/
## Second_Brain_Orchestrator_Removal_Mandate_2026-09-23.md
 39|
*40|- Brain driver/orchestrator/coordinator role creation, model allowlists, or privileged coordinator admission.
 41|- Agent/worker dispatch, task scheduling, lifecycle mirroring, completion authority, replay authority, execution leases, reservation/settlement, cleanup barriers, or worker resurrection.
 42|- Brain enforcement of native tool access, model/role assignment, worker budgets, or host task STOP/cancellation policy.
 43|- Protected coordinator issuer/bootstrap/custody work that exists exclusively to support these removed operations.
## Second_Brain_V3_Orchestration_Free_Roadmap_2026-09-23.md
 10|
*11|The native harness decides who does work, which model is used, which tools may run, and when execution starts, stops, retries, or completes. Brain supplies the right permitted knowledge and preserves trustworthy memory. It does not own the task lifecycle.
 12|
 13|Automatic context injection remains. Multiple agents can use one authorized knowledge base. Skills can become more discoverable, precise, reusable, and verifiable. None of those capabilities requires Brain to create agents, appoint a coordinator, or control their tools.
 14|
...
 33|
*34|Remove coordinator recognition and custody improvements; protected worker issuance; driver/worker planes; agent or model routing; task admission; worker budget reservations; execution leases; completion/settlement/replay authority; native lifecycle supervision; agent scheduling/prefetch; worker recovery/resurrection; delegated coordinator hierarchies; and a multi-agent runtime.
 35|
 36|Remove improvements to an orchestration handoff layer whose sole purpose is retaining those guarantees. Do not recreate them as a Brainstem executive, workflow engine, autonomous supervisor, resource governor, or cognitive operating system. Names do not change scope.
 37|
...
 117|
*118|The earlier charter proposed warm whole-turn incremental local overhead of at most 10 ms median / 50 ms p95, with a separate incremental cold-start target of at most 100 ms p95. These remain proposals until explicitly frozen for evaluation, not demonstrated current performance. Do not grant each new component a separate full-turn allowance or silently relax a failing threshold.
 119|
 120|For useful-memory tasks, measure verified task quality, total tokens, time, local resources, cache validation, retries where observable, and the construction/maintenance costs of the Brain mechanism. Native execution can be measured without being controlled by Brain. Account for gaps rather than inventing full coverage.
 121|
